description: This Java class 'ShoppingCartData' is an entity representing shopping cart information in an e-commerce application. It extends 'ShopEntity' and implements 'Serializable', and includes fields such as message, code, quantity, total, subTotal, and lists for totals and shopping cart items. It is annotated with Spring annotations indicating it is a prototype-scoped component.

classes.name: ShoppingCartData
classes.description: A data entity class for shopping cart details in an e-commerce system, serializable, with Spring component annotations.
